picks.what_it_does: Opus Genetics makes eye treatments, including an eye drop already sold as RYZUMVI, and is asking the FDA to approve it for age-related blurry near vision (presbyopia).
picks.catalyst: FDA decision on the phentolamine 0.75% (RYZUMVI) sNDA for presbyopia. The goal date is Sat Oct 17, so under the weekend-FDA rule the decision is expected on Fri Oct 16. Hold into Mon Oct 19 if nothing is announced by the Friday close.
picks.catalyst_date: 2026-10-17 (Saturday PDUFA goal date; FDA action most likely Fri 2026-10-16)
picks.date_basis: Company-confirmed PDUFA goal date (sNDA acceptance release, Feb 2026), repeated on October PDUFA calendars
picks.why_positive: Approval would extend an already-approved drug into the large presbyopia market, backed by two positive Phase 3 trials (VEGA-2, VEGA-3), with no known deficiencies and no advisory committee. A plausible move is +15% to +60% on approval, against about -30% to -50% on a rejection.

picks.what_it_does: Verastem Oncology sells a drug combination for a rare ovarian cancer and is developing VS-7375, a pill that blocks the KRAS G12D cancer mutation in pancreatic, lung and bowel cancers.
picks.catalyst: VS-7375 investor event on Wed Oct 14 at 8:00am ET (before the open). An NYU Langone investigator presents the first efficacy data and updated safety data in pancreatic, lung and colorectal cancer.
picks.date_basis: Company-confirmed (Sept 8, 2026 Business Wire release and company investor-events page)
picks.why_positive: This is the first efficacy readout for an oral KRAS G12D inhibitor across three large tumour types, and competitive response rates in pancreatic or colorectal cancer could re-rate the stock by +20% to +50% on the day. The stock already rose about 9% last week and the market cap is derived rather than quoted, so sell-the-news risk is real; it is roughly a coin flip.

picks.what_it_does: Bannerman Energy is developing the Etango uranium mine in Namibia, and its construction financing with partner CNOL closed in September.
picks.catalyst: September-quarter 2026 activities report (last year's equivalent came out Thu Oct 16, 2025), which may firm up timing of the Etango final investment decision (FID), guided to Q4 2026. The FID itself is undated and could be announced at any time.
picks.catalyst_date: Est. 2026-10-15/16 (pattern from Oct 16, 2025 release; unconfirmed; could slip to Week 2)
picks.date_basis: Pattern estimate from the prior-year September-quarter release date; FID guided to Q4 2026 with no specific date
picks.why_positive: Financing and the CNOL partnership closed on Sep 24, so the FID is the next step, and a quarterly report that confirms imminent FID, or the FID itself, could lift the stock +10% to +25%. A plain quarterly update would likely be a non-event, so this is a lower-conviction filler (about US$2.3 per share at 0.65-0.70 USD/AUD; price dated Jul 27).

picks.what_it_does: Vir Biotechnology develops antibody and RNA medicines, led by a two-drug combination for hepatitis delta, a severe chronic liver infection.
picks.catalyst: Phase 3 ECLIPSE 1 topline for tobevibart plus elebsiran in hepatitis delta. FLOATING catalyst: the company guides only to Q4 2026, so it is a low-probability fill for this week.
picks.catalyst_date: Q4 2026 (no specific date; low chance it falls Oct 12-16)
picks.date_basis: Company guidance window (Q2 2026 results, Aug 5, 2026); not week-specific
picks.why_positive: Phase 2 SOLSTICE showed 88% undetectable HDV RNA at week 96, so a positive Phase 3 is more likely than not and could add +40% to +100%. The main risk is timing, because the readout may well land after the competition ends.

The data are early-stage and a pre-congress run-up is possible; price (Aug 24) and market cap (reported US$222M-566M) are unconfirmed.

picks.what_it_does: Immatics engineers patients' immune T cells to attack cancers that carry the PRAME marker, and also develops antibody-like bispecific drugs against the same target.

picks.why_positive: A proffered-paper oral for next-generation CD8-enhanced PRAME TCR-T data gives two tradeable moments (Oct 19 abstract, Oct 23 oral), and strong response and durability numbers could add +15% to +35%. These are Phase 1 data and the abstract reveals much of the content early, so the move may come on Monday and fade into Friday.

picks.what_it_does: Tiziana Life Sciences is testing a nasal-spray antibody called foralumab for progressive multiple sclerosis.

picks.why_positive: Earlier expanded-access data were encouraging (14 patients improved or stable), and a clean placebo-controlled signal in a micro-cap could move the stock +50% to +200%. Odds are low (about 20% probability of success per BiopharmaWatch) and the price is just above US$1.00, so check the live quote first.

picks.what_it_does: Climb Bio develops antibody drugs for immune-driven kidney diseases, including budoprutug for membranous nephropathy and CLYM116 for IgA nephropathy.

picks.why_positive: An oral slot suggests the first membranous nephropathy patient data are presentable, and strong remission or B-cell depletion numbers could move the stock +30% to +100%. It breaks the price screen (about US$15) and ran up from about US$11 into the event, so sell-the-news risk is real.

picks.why_positive: LBL-024 is the first PD-L1/4-1BB bispecific to reach registration review, and two ESMO orals could add +10% to +30% of visibility-driven upside. The price (about US$8.6) is stale from mid-July, the market cap is unconfirmed (stale HK$12.6B, about US$1.6B), and the stock already jumped about 30% on the ESMO selection in July.

picks.what_it_does: Inovio makes DNA-based medicines, and its lead drug INO-3107 treats recurrent respiratory papillomatosis, a rare disease that causes growths in the airway.
picks.catalyst: FDA PDUFA goal date for the INO-3107 BLA (accelerated approval) on Fri Oct 30. A decision after the close would trade Mon Nov 2, so hold over the weekend if no news by the close.

picks.why_positive: Approval of the only near-term asset could move the stock +80% to +200%, and one calendar puts approval odds at about 70%. picks.what_it_does: JetBlue is a US low-cost airline based in New York with hubs at JFK, Boston and Fort Lauderdale.
picks.catalyst: Q3 2026 earnings, expected Tue Oct 27 before the open (aggregators). Not yet company-confirmed; TipRanks and Investing.com show a Nov 3 estimate, which would move it to Week 4. The date notice is expected around Oct 13-14.

picks.what_it_does: GSI Technology designs specialty memory chips and an AI processor called Gemini APU that computes inside memory, for edge-AI, defence and aerospace systems.

picks.why_positive: The 52-week range of about US$1.62-18.15 shows the stock can move several-fold on AI-chip news, so an APU design win or deployment update could bring +20% to +50%. Revenue guidance is flat (US$5.7-6.5M), so the direction is a coin flip.

picks.what_it_does: Bausch Health is a heavily indebted drug and medical-device company (gut drugs, dermatology, aesthetics) that controls the eye-care company Bausch + Lomb.
picks.catalyst: Q3 2026 results after the close on Wed Oct 28, with a 5:00pm ET call; first reaction Thu Oct 29. Bausch + Lomb reports the same day.
picks.date_basis: Company-confirmed (Oct 6, 2026 release)
picks.why_positive: Because the equity is small relative to the debt, progress on debt reduction or Bausch + Lomb value can move the shares sharply, and the analyst target of about US$7.50 sits above spot. Expect a moderate move of roughly +5% to +15% on a good print; it is a coin flip rather than a high-beta jumper.

picks.what_it_does: Teladoc Health runs virtual doctor visits, chronic-condition programmes and the BetterHelp online-therapy service.

The setup is weak (FY revenue guide cut, Hold consensus), so the chance of a positive move is below even.

picks.what_it_does: BitFuFu is a Singapore-based bitcoin miner that rents mining power to retail customers and also mines bitcoin itself.

Monthly updates rarely move stocks much and the price is only about 23% above the US$1.00 floor, so this is a low-conviction filler.

picks.what_it_does: Redwire builds spacecraft parts such as solar arrays and structures, and supplies in-space manufacturing and defence space systems.

picks.why_positive: Q2 revenue rose 90% year on year to a record US$542M backlog, with 2026 guidance of US$450-500M, so a beat-and-raise on a high-beta space name could bring +15% to +30%. It sits above the US$10 price preference and near the US$3B ceiling.
